utterances.text: No. We will have to stop here. We have been having a very long day ourselves and everyone here. And I think also the moment asks for an adjournment. We'll continue tomorrow afternoon, 2.15. Yes, Mr. Di Fazio.

utterances.speaker: MR. DI FAZIO
utterances.text: Just an inquiry, of course. Madam Vidovic may not know the answer, but can she give any indication how much longer she will be?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I don't know, but I think she will be able to finish tomorrow. Looking at the list of documents left, more or less, and the rhythm that --

utterances.speaker: MR. DI FAZIO
utterances.text: That's what I thought.

utterances.speaker: MS. VIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I will endeavour, Your Honour, but this is an important witness for us. I'm doing my best to be as short as possible. I hope I'll finish tomorrow, otherwise I don't know.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. We'll -- yes, Mr. Di Fazio.

utterances.speaker: MR. DI FAZIO
utterances.text: I'm sorry, Your Honours, it won't take a moment. If that happens, if we take up -- if Madam Vidovic takes the lion's share of tomorrow, then it's going to leave about a five-hour interval for me to get home and prepare. I mean, obviously I've got a lot of material now to work on and I will do that. But Thursday night, because we start in the morning Friday morning, you understand --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes, Friday is the morning.

utterances.speaker: MR. DI FAZIO
utterances.text: -- and afternoons and nights are invaluable to me for preparing preparation of cross-examination, that's halved on Thursday night because we start on Friday morning.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I don't know what to tell you --

utterances.speaker: MR. DI FAZIO
utterances.text: I don't --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I don't think it is possible because I tried to shift --

utterances.speaker: MR. DI FAZIO
utterances.text: Your Honours --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: -- some of these sittings to the mornings --

utterances.speaker: MR. DI FAZIO
utterances.text: -- I'm not complaining.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: -- but it was not successful.

utterances.speaker: MR. DI FAZIO
utterances.text: I'm not complaining about it. I'm not suggesting anything. But I wonder if I -- if I prepare as much as I can tonight and as much as I can on Thursday night, if I were to finish a little earlier on Friday and only if it were not possible for us to finish with this witness completely, completely, on Friday, would you be minded to give me a little time to -- on Friday to complete the job on the Monday? That's what I'm -- that's what I'm asking. I would only -- I would only seek that if I was -- if I could assure you that there was no way that we could finish this witness regardless, and I would not dream of --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: That would mean deciding now, not knowing how much actually the Defence is going to require for --

utterances.speaker: MR. DI FAZIO
utterances.text: Can I just say leave it as is --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: You'll sit down together - listen - and try to re-build what, in my opinion, may have been to a large extent destroyed. Please try to sit down together and see --

utterances.speaker: MR. DI FAZIO
utterances.text: I'm sure Madam Vidovic is cooperative with us on this regard, and just purely and simply a question of timing but that's all.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: But at the moment I can't -- I don't know how much time they require --

utterances.speaker: MR. DI FAZIO
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honours --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: -- for --

utterances.speaker: MR. DI FAZIO
utterances.text: I'll leave the issue as it stands.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: We'll see. Okay, thanks everybody. Again, we've overstayed by a few minutes. We'll meet again tomorrow afternoon.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Thursday, the 8th day of December, 2005, at 2.15 p.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 7.05 p.m.,
